articles.title: Record-Breaking Crowds Prove the World Cup Is the Biggest Party in America Right Now
articles.summary: Imagine 25 million people watching one soccer game! That's how many tuned in for Team USA's first World Cup match. From Boston to LA, fans are packing stadiums and festivals in record numbers.

articles.title: Why Kids with Autism Are Getting Special Swim Lessons in Florida
articles.summary: Kids with autism are 160 times more likely to drown. In Florida, a new law helps families get swim lessons. Five-year-old Mackenzie loves the water, and her lessons at the YMCA are teaching her to stay safe.

articles.title: A Big Fight Over Who Gets to Vote: The 90-Day Rule Explained
articles.summary: There's a law that says states can't remove lots of voters from the rolls right before an election. But Republicans want to change how it works. The Supreme Court will decide.
